name: Little Princess
source: The first game for Windows OS of Champion Soft (the later Alice Soft), contains pretty girl Miki and young warrior Kentarou trying to save her beloved one kidnapped by some evil guy.
translation: Champion Soft——後來的AliceSoft——推出的首款Windows遊戲。美少女來水美樹遭惡人綁架，年輕戰士小川健太郎將設法救回心愛之人。
